lines.zh: 我一步一步，学树枝摇晃。
lines.en: Step by step, I sway the way branches do.
My legs are thin as snapped-off twigs.
Walk slower, and no one can tell.
The wind leans left, so I lean left.

lines.zh: 我的关节一节一节地动。
lines.en: My joints move one segment at a time.
I stepped on a dry twig; it snapped.
One step, then a long, long pause.
I creep upward along the tree trunk.
Dew hangs on the spines of my legs.
Moving, I look like a shaking leaf.
This stretch will take me all afternoon.
Don't watch me; I'm not really moving.

lines.zh: 我换了根更像树枝的姿势。
lines.en: I shift into a more branch-like pose.
Five steps, and then I stop again.

lines.zh: 我换了个枝杈，挪得很慢
lines.en: I switch twigs, moving very slowly
The wind stops, so I stop too

lines.zh: 我就是一根树枝，别管我。
lines.en: I'm a branch. Please ignore me entirely.
A bird flew right past my branch.
I hold still and let the wind pass.

lines.zh: 这样站着，时间过得很快。
lines.en: Standing like this, time slips by quickly.

lines.zh: 我的身体和树皮一个颜色。
lines.en: My body matches this bark exactly.

lines.zh: 有只虫子爬上了我的头。
lines.en: A little bug climbed onto my head.
I even made my breathing quieter.

lines.zh: 树影移过去，我才动一下。
lines.en: When the shadow moved, I shifted once.
Staying like this is the safest thing.

lines.zh: 我把自己摆成四十五度。
lines.en: I set myself at a forty-five degree angle.
The ants think I'm a little bridge.
No one has noticed me in quite a while.
Tell me — do I look like a twig?

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，你没发现。
lines.en: I've watched you the whole time, unnoticed.
You've been looking for me a while.
Don't poke me; I'd fall off the tree.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很小，你看不见。
lines.en: My eyes are tiny; you won't spot them.
I slowly turn to face where you are.

lines.zh: 你背后那根，其实才是我。
lines.en: That thing behind you is actually me.
Us staring like this feels quite fair.
You blinked. I didn't.
I lift a front leg as a greeting.
One section of my leg snapped off.

lines.zh: 一记重击，我从枝头掉了。
lines.en: One heavy blow, and I dropped from my perch.
I'm playing dead. It really hurts.
My whole disguise is ruined now.
Don't squeeze — I'd break in two.
On the ground I can't right myself.
My casing split, showing the soft part.
This hurts worse than falling off the tree.
I curl into a knot of small twigs.
You saw through me after all.
You're trying to tempt me down with a leaf?
I'm not hungry, but I could take a look.
That leaf's swaying rhythm is all wrong.
I extend one leg. Just the one.

lines.zh: 你把叶子举那么高做什么。
lines.en: Why are you holding that leaf so high?
I moved. That's a rare thing already.

lines.zh: 叶缘的齿很像我身上的刺。
lines.en: The leaf's edge looks like my own spines.
Bring it a bit closer and I'll come down.
I pretend not to care. I do.
That mouthful of leaf will take ages.
I swayed hard from that bump.

lines.zh: 你碰到我时，我差点掉下去。
lines.en: When you touched me I nearly dropped.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆动，装成被风吹的。
lines.en: I sway slowly, as if the wind did it.
Your hand is far harder than bark.
I didn't fall; my legs held tight.
After the bump I froze completely still.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，你先道歉吧。
lines.en: We bumped. You should apologize first.

lines.zh: 我的腿卡在你的袖子里。
lines.en: One of my legs is caught in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 这一下让我从枝头滑了寸。
lines.en: That slid me an inch along the branch.
Don't push — I really would snap.

lines.zh: 我们两根树枝靠在一起。
lines.en: Two twigs lean together on the branch.
It's thinner than me, and quieter.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢晃，一样的节奏。
lines.en: We sway slowly in the very same rhythm.

lines.zh: 谁也没动，这样就算在一起了。
lines.en: Neither moved. That counts as being together.
It rested a leg across my back.

lines.zh: 我们像两段断枝拼成一截。
lines.en: We look like two broken twigs fitted.
This tree is enough for the two of us.
The eggs will go on the underside of leaves.
It sways once; I sway once.

lines.zh: 很久之后，我们一起往下爬。
lines.en: Much later, we climb down together.

lines.zh: 我用前腿夹起一片叶子。
lines.en: I pick up a leaf with my front legs.
It weighs even less than I do.

lines.zh: 我举着它，像举着一片旗。
lines.en: I hold it up like a little flag.
I drag the leaf one whole step.
Someone dropped it. It's mine now.
I hide it underneath my legs.

lines.zh: 夹着东西走，我晃得更厉害。
lines.en: Carrying it, I sway even more than usual.
This leaf will last me two days.
It's hanging off my knee joint.

lines.zh: 我带着它慢慢往高处爬。
lines.en: I climb higher with it, very slowly.
That young leaf sits right in the wind.

lines.zh: 有东西碰到了这根树枝。
lines.en: Something touched this branch of mine.
I'm waiting for it to come nearer.
There's a bug chewing bark over there.

lines.zh: 我注意到的比你看到的多。
lines.en: I notice more than you'd ever see.

lines.zh: 这棵树的叶子开始卷了。
lines.en: The leaves on this tree are curling.
The shadow below has changed direction.
Footsteps — right by the tree roots.

lines.zh: 我朝那片嫩芽偏了偏头。
lines.en: I tilt toward that patch of new shoots.

lines.zh: 我想移到更亮的那根枝。
lines.en: I want to move to that brighter branch.

lines.zh: 那只鸟停在离我三寸处。
lines.en: That bird perched three inches away.
I've decided to change spots tonight.
I turn my body toward it, very slowly.
One step, two, and then I stop.
It hasn't seen me. That's just right.
I work my way along the branch.
My color goes paler in this light.
Three inches away — I can still wait.
The moment it moves, I freeze.
I shrink myself into a short section.

lines.zh: 这条路我走了半个时辰。
lines.en: This short route has taken me an hour.

lines.zh: 它的影子正落在我身上。
lines.en: Its shadow is falling right on me.

lines.zh: 我不急，树枝有的是时间。
lines.en: No rush; branches have all the time.
A little closer and I'll reach it.
My legs have spines that can prick.
I raise a front leg and jab.

lines.zh: 这一下轻得像被树枝划到。
lines.en: That was as light as a scratch from a branch.
I shoved with my whole body.

lines.zh: 你差点以为是自己蹭到了树。
lines.en: You'd almost think you brushed a tree.
I kicked once. Only once.
A leaf is still stuck on my spine.
Done fighting, I turn back into a twig.
It wasn't heavy, but it was sharp.
I shoved, then wobbled from it.
I hatched beneath a leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 一出生，我就是根小树枝。
lines.en: From birth I was a little twig.

lines.zh: 风吹过，我和叶子一起晃。
lines.en: Wind came, and I swayed with the leaves.

lines.zh: 这棵树的皮刚好合我的色。
lines.en: This tree's bark matches my color exactly.

lines.zh: 我找到了一个安静的枝杈。
lines.en: I found myself a quiet fork of branch.

lines.zh: 四周的落叶和我的腿一样细。
lines.en: The fallen leaves are as thin as my legs.
I climbed up and then stopped moving.
Even the big bugs take me for wood.
The light here is soft — perfect for me.
From now on I live on this branch.

lines.zh: 我的腿一碰火就卷起来。
lines.en: My legs curl at the first touch of flame.

lines.zh: 我在落叶里找自己的腿。
lines.en: I search the leaf litter for my leg.
Underwater I can't sway; I just sink.

lines.zh: 一声响，我从树上飞出去。
lines.en: A bang, and I flew off the tree.
Something grazed along my back.

lines.zh: 紫光把我从伪装里拉出来。
lines.en: Violet light pulls me out of my disguise.
I haven't touched a leaf in ages.

lines.zh: 雷光下，我的伪装没用了。
lines.en: In lightning my camouflage is useless.
No branches here, and no wind either.
